data.headline: Suzanne Kracke — REALTOR® Associate
data.body: Suzanne is a REALTOR® Associate with Green Light Realty, serving buyers and sellers across Middlesex, Monmouth, and Ocean County. Reach out for local market expertise and guidance from first showing to closing day.

data.title: About Suzanne
bio: Currently teaching full-time, I bring dedication, organization, and a people-first approach to every real estate transaction.  I have had the opportunity to assist family and friends with their buying and selling needs, building a strong foundation of trust and hands-on experience.

Outside of real estate, I am happily married, a proud mother of three sons, and a grandmother to four wonderful grandchildren.  In my free time, I enjoy spending quality moments with my family, walking, reading, and knitting, these interests keep me grounded, patient, and attentive to detail.
